definition: Auxiliary participle used in perfect participle clauses.

definition: Becoming fully aware of something as a fact.

definition: Taking a brief or hurried look.

definition: Perfect passive participle clause denoting prior instruction.
exampleSentence: Having been briefed on cyber vulnerabilities, the network administrators reconfigured the enterprise firewalls.

definition: Past participle clause denoting meeting adversity.

Whilst conceding that delivery delays occurred, the contractor disputed claims of mechanical inferiority.

definition: Present participle clause denoting execution of orders.
